audit_note: Until the Google Cloud project passes the YouTube API Services audit (https://support.google.com/youtube/contact/yt_api_form), API uploads are locked private for good. So Approve opens a posting kit and Vijay posts from the YouTube app; scripts/youtube.py finds and tracks it.
